rules.title: The Game, Field, Players and Equipment

articles.text: The game shall be played between two teams of not more than 11 players each, on a rectangular field and with an inflated ball of specified shape and size.
For any free kick, a free-kick line shall be established at the 35-yard line for the kicking team and the 25-yard line for the receiving team.
A fair catch is a catch of a free kick or scrimmage kick that is beyond the neutral zone by a player of the receiving team who has given a valid signal.
If a player of the receiving team signals for a fair catch on a free kick and catches the ball inside his own 25-yard line, the ball becomes dead and is placed at the 25-yard line.

rules.title: Conduct of Players and Others Subject to the Rules

articles.text: Targeting and Making Forcible Contact to Head or Neck Area of a Defenseless Player. No player shall target and make forcible contact to the head or neck area of a defenseless opponent with the helmet, forearm, hand, fist, elbow or shoulder.
Targeting and Making Forcible Contact With the Crown of the Helmet. No player shall target and make forcible contact against an opponent with the crown of his helmet.
